name: Propofol
summary: A very short-acting sedative that is usually given at the start of general anesthesia and for maintenance of the prior. This drug is extremely dangerous to use outside of medical settings If one is to use this drug outside of a medical setting, it is strongly recommended having another experienced individual in-person to monitor ones pulse and breathing among other concerns.
advisory: Avoid: If in a non-hospital setting, nearly all substances should be avoided. If one is to use this drug outside of a medical setting, it is strongly recommended having another experienced individual in-person to monitor ones pulse and breathing among other concerns. If your pulse drops below 50, or if you are taking less than 10 breaths per minute, it is strongly recommended to call an ambulance. In some cases the user's body may be discoloured, in which case they are likely unconscious.
doseBasis: Note: These dosages are extremely tentative. The drug has a high risk outside of medical settings, extensive research is strongly recommended.

pharmacology.text: Propofol's proposed mechanism of actionsuggests potentiation of GABAA receptor activity by acting as a GABAA receptor positive allosteric modulator, which slows receptor channel-closing time. At high doses, propofol may activate GABAA receptors in the absence of GABA, behaving as a GABAA receptor agonist as well. Propofol analogs also seem to act as sodium channel blockers.
pharmacology.kind: GABAA receptor agonist; sedative; general anesthetic

uses.text: Propofol is the active component of an intravenous anesthetic used for induction and maintenance of general anesthesia. Propofol was first marketed under the brand name Diprivan. Intravenous administration is used to induce unconsciousness, after which anesthesia may be maintained using a combination of medications.
uses.recreational: Recreational use of the drug via self-administration has been reported but is relatively rare due to its potency and the level of monitoring required for safe use. Critically, a steep dose-response curve makes recreational use of propofol very dangerous, and deaths from self-administration continue to be reported. The short-term effects sought via recreational use include mild euphoria, hallucinations, and disinhibition.

sideEffects.text: One of propofol's most common side effects is pain on injection, especially in smaller veins, due to activation of the sensory nerve pain receptor, TRPA1,. This can be mitigated by pretreatment with lidocaine or slower infusion in a large vein (antecubital fossa).
sideEffects.dependence: Physical: Very high; Psychological: no data

summaryZh: 丙泊酚 舊稱（雙）異丙酚，是一種烷基酚類的快速短效靜脈注射麻醉藥，用於全身麻醉的誘導和維持以及危重患者鎮靜；具有麻醉誘導起效快、甦醒迅速、恢復較為舒適，以及副作用（例如：嗜睡、甦醒後噁心 、嘔吐）發生率低等優點。
summaryZhHans: 丙泊酚 旧称（双）异丙酚，是一种烷基酚类的快速短效静脉注射麻醉药，用于全身麻醉的诱导和维持以及危重患者镇静；具有麻醉诱导起效快、苏醒迅速、恢复较为舒适，以及副作用（例如：嗜睡、苏醒后恶心 、呕吐）发生率低等优点。

fact.en: Propofol was developed at the British company ICI by the chemist John Glen, who received a Lasker Award for it in 2018. Its milky white look, which comes from the fat emulsion it is mixed in, earned it the nickname milk of amnesia.
fact.zh: 丙泊酚由英國 ICI 公司的化學家 John Glen 開發，他因此在 2018 年獲得拉斯克獎。它因溶在脂肪乳劑中而呈乳白色，被戲稱為「失憶牛奶」。
fact.zhHans: 丙泊酚由英国 ICI 公司的化学家 John Glen 开发，他因此在 2018 年获得拉斯克奖。它因溶在脂肪乳剂中而呈乳白色，被戏称为「失忆牛奶」。
